IONTradeConsideration.title: IONTradeConsideration
IONTradeConsideration.description: ION trade consideration attributes. Inherits directly from RetailConsideration v2.1 and refines inherited breakup taxDetail objects with the shared IONTaxDetail schema.

breakup.description: Inherited RetailConsideration price breakup, refined so each taxDetail object may carry IONTaxDetail classification and compliance fields.

commission.description: Commission the order comes to: what the seller (BPP) pays the buyer app (BAP), deducted from the seller's payout. Not a charge to the buyer, and not part of breakup or totalAmount. Set only on the contract's price consideration in force; the offer's commission terms are IONTradeOffer.policies.commission (see IONCommission).

IONCommission.title: IONCommission
IONCommission.description:
The commission an order comes to: what the seller (BPP) pays the buyer app (BAP), deducted from the seller's payout at settlement. Not a charge to the buyer, and not part of breakup or totalAmount. Set only on the contract's price consideration in force; the offer's terms are the named entries of IONTradeOffer.policies.commission.
feeAmount is the total commission for the items still ordered: the sum, over every offer still ordered, of all its policies.commission entries. The BPP sets it in on_select and on_init and recomputes it in on_cancel and on_update after cancellations and returns.
When every offer still ordered has exactly one commission entry and they all share the same PERCENT terms, the contract repeats that feeType, feeValue and appliesTo; otherwise feeType is AMOUNT and feeValue is the total.
At reconciliation the settlement's commission.value (IONSettlementReconciliation) equals feeAmount.

feeType.description: PERCENT repeats the shared PERCENT terms of the offers ordered. AMOUNT means feeValue is the order's total commission in the consideration currency.

feeValue.description: Percentage (0-100) when feeType is PERCENT; the order's total commission in the consideration currency when feeType is AMOUNT.

appliesTo.description: Base for a PERCENT commission. ITEM_TOTAL is the item value excluding tax, delivery and packing; ORDER_TOTAL includes tax. Only for feeType PERCENT.

feeAmount.description: Total commission in the consideration currency for the items still ordered: the sum over every offer still ordered of all its policies.commission entries. Equals the settlement's commission.value at reconciliation.
